limitations: Image completeness is determined by the build report, not by the roster size.
No claim that every image is the latest or globally highest-resolution.
Automatically selected product views still require visual review.

assetPolicy.logo: Official primary/team marks. No Wikipedia lead-image fallback.
assetPolicy.mlbJersey: Front product photos. No Gameday batter illustrations.
assetPolicy.export: Include selected teams with valid logos. Jerseys are optional; missing logos are reported and skipped.
assetPolicy.newLeagues: NPB/KBO/TPVL/NFL; official team marks, no random article lead images.
assetPolicy.jersey: Official team shops or licensed catalogs; front/product image preferred; rear views and souvenir products rejected.
assetPolicy.cache: Original 77 team IDs and IndexedDB key are unchanged.
assetPolicy.v5: No raster downsampling or enlargement. Preserve SVG original and 4096 px compatibility fallback. Front-view selection retains existing checks. Source URLs do not imply successful download.
